items.text: The Iranian government made an agreement with other countries not to work on developing nuclear weapons. In 2018, the US pulled out of that agreement. Last year, Iran enriched uranium at levels a little above what agreed to. The Iranian government said that it would enrich more uranium if it did not get relief from sanctions . The other countries that were part of the deal – China, France, Germany, Russia, and the UK – have been working to sustain the agreement. Recently, the US killed Iranian General Qasem Soleimani, and now people are worried that Iran will restart the progress on its nuclear program due to revenge. However, Iran has 5 percent enriched uranium now; it needs 90 percent enriched uranium to create a bomb. Difficult words: enriched uranium (uranium is a special substance that breaks down unusually; if you enrich it by adding other substances to it, you can use it to create a power plant or a weapon), sanction (a punishment on a country, such as not trading or doing business with that country), sustain (continue, support). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Iranian government made an agreement with other countries not to work on nuclear weapons. In 2018, the US pulled out of the agreement. Last year, Iran worked with enriched uranium . It said that it would do more work if it did not get relief from sanctions . Recently, the US killed an important Iranian general, and now people are worried that Iran will restart the work on its nuclear program as revenge. However, Iran does not have enough enriched uranium to make a nuclear weapon yet. Difficult words: pull out (leave), enriched uranium (uranium is a special metal; if you enrich it by adding other things to it, you can make things such as a weapon), relief from sanctions (stop a punishment on a country, such as let the country get help or trade with other countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Iranian government makes an agreement with other countries. It says that it will not work on nuclear weapons. Other countries also put sanctions on Iran. In 2018, the US government leaves the agreement. Last year, Iran works on its nuclear program. It is not supposed to do this. Iran says that it needs help from the sanctions. It says that it is going to work on its program even more if it does not get help. Recently, the US kills an important Iranian military leader. People are worried. Iran may want to make a nuclear weapon because of this. However, Iran does not have enough supplies to do this yet. Difficult words: agreement (when a person or a group agrees to do something, a deal), nuclear (a type of power that is very strong), sanctions (rules on a country that make it hard for the country to do work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Actress Akwafina acted in movies such as “Crazy Rich Asians” and “Ocean’s 8,” and on Sunday, she won a Golden Globe for best actress in the movie “The Farewell.” This made history, as she is the first woman of Asian descent to win this award. The Hollywood Foreign Press Association (HFPA) classified “The Farewell” as a comedy, but it was also Awkwafina’s first dramatic role. It was one of the most critically acclaimed movies this year, but the HFPA said that it was ineligible for best comedy as more than half of the movie is in Mandarin instead of English. Difficult words: classify (to define, to say what something is), critically acclaim (to say that something is very good compared to other things), ineligible (not eligible for something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Actress Akwafina acted in movies like “Crazy Rich Asians” and “Ocean’s 8.” On Sunday, she won a Golden Globe for best actress in the movie “The Farewell.” This made history because she was the first woman of Asian descent to win this award. The Hollywood Foreign Press Association (HFPA) said that “The Farewell” was a comedy, but it was also Awkwafina’s first dramatic role. Critics acclaimed the movie, but the HFPA said that it could not win for best comedy because more than half of the movie is in Mandarin instead of English. Difficult words: make history (to be the first time that something happens), descent (background, where your family or relatives come from in the world), acclaim (to talk about positively). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Actress Awkwafina acts in some famous movies. These are movies like “Crazy Rich Asians” and “Ocean’s 8.” On Sunday, she wins a Golden Globe award. It is for lead actress in the movie “The Farewell.” This is important. She is the first woman of Asian descent to win this award. A movie organization says that “The Farewell” is a comedy. It is also Awkafina’s first dramatic movie. The movie cannot win an award for the best comedy. The characters speak mostly Mandarin in the movie instead of English. Difficult words: lead (an important job), descent (where your family comes from in the world), dramatic (serious, sometimes sad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Interpol, the International Police Organization, issued a wanted notice for a former Nissan chairman named Carlos Ghosn who fled Japan for Lebanon last week. Ghosn faces charges of financial misconduct in Japan, and he was living under house arrest before he ran away. Lebanon’s justice minister said that the country received a Red Notice about Ghosn on Thursday. A Red Notice is a request from Interpol to locate and provisionally arrest a wanted person. The justice minister said that the country will respect the notice, but he added that Lebanese authorities have no charges against Ghosn because he entered Lebanon using a legal passport. It is not clear how Ghosn managed to leave Japan because he gave his passports to his lawyers. According to Turkish media, several people were arrested to investigate how he fled Japan to Lebanon through Istanbul. Difficult words: flee (to escape), misconduct (bad behavior by someone in a position of authority), provisionally (temporarily). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The International police, Interpol, is looking for a past chairman of the company Nissan named Carlos Ghosn. Ghosn was under house arrest in Japan because of financial problems, but he escaped to Lebanon. Interpol sent a Red Notice to Lebanon, which is a request to arrest a person who committed a crime. Local authorities can arrest this person and return him or her to the country where he or she committed the crime. Lebanon wants to respect the notice, but Ghosn came to Lebanon with a legal passport, so Lebanon does not have any charges against him. Turkish police arrested several people to find out how Ghosn escaped to Lebanon because he got there through Turkey. Difficult words: house arrest (the state when a person is in home as a prisoner), respect (to follow, to listen), charge (a formal statement that someone committed a crime). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japanese authorities want to arrest the past chairman of the company Nissan. His name is Carlos Ghosn. Japanese police say that Ghosn must stay in his home. However, last week he escapes to Lebanon. It is not clear how he escapes. Lawyers have his passport. Japan asks Interpol for help. Interpol contacts Lebanon. It sends a special document with information about Ghosn. Lebanon must act. Lebanon can arrest Ghosn. The country can return him to Japan. However, it is not easy. Lebanese authorities say that Ghosn comes to the country with a legal passport. Therefore, there are no charges against Ghosn in Lebanon. Turkey is helping to find out how Ghosn gets to Lebanon. He travels through Turkey to get there. Difficult words: chairman (a person with an important job in a company), Interpol (the International Police Organization), charge (a situation when authorities officially say that someone does something bad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Pope Francis says that world governments need to make sure that they make health care accessible to everyone in their countries. This request came during his annual World Day of the Sick speech on Friday. The Pope criticized the lack of medical care available to people in poverty , and he urged world leaders not to neglect the problem. He also asked governments to not allow financial concerns to push health problems aside, and he called for attacks against medical professionals serving in regions of war to end. He said that such attacks do not serve the interests of anyone. Difficult words: annual (taking place once a year), poverty (the state of being extremely poor), neglect (to not care properly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Friday, Pope Francis gave his speech on the World Day of the Sick. He said that world governments must make sure that there is health care available for all people. The Pope criticized the fact that people who live in poverty do not get medical care when they need it. He said that world leaders must focus on the problem and not let money problems push health aside . The Pope also said that attacks on medical professionals who work in war areas must stop. He believes that these attacks do not help end wars. Difficult words: speech (when someone speaks in front of people), poverty (when people are extremely poor), push aside (to ignore). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People do not get good health care in many parts of the world. Very poor people do not get any health care. This is bad when they need it. The Pope talks about this fact during his talk on the World Day of the Sick. He says that world leaders must make sure that all people get health care. The Pope thinks that money is the reason why world leaders ignore this problem. They must care about people’s health more. The Pope also speaks about doctors who work in areas with war. Their jobs are very hard. Their jobs are dangerous because sometimes soldiers attack them. The Pope believes that this does not help end wars. Difficult words: the Pope (the leader of the religion called the Roman Catholics; the Pope has a job in the Vatican), reason (why something happens), ignore (to not care about a problem). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

North Korea may soon start nuclear and missile tests, as the North Korean leader, Kim Jong-un, said that he does not feel bound to his suspension of such tests. Kim complained that he did not get anything in return for the suspension. Instead, he pointed out that the US imposed more sanctions on the country and continued military trainings with South Korea and sell it weapons. Kim stopped to negotiations with the US administration, and he warned that North Korea will show a new strategic weapon in the near future. The US president, Donald Trump, told reporters that the relationship between North Korea and the US is very good. Trump also reminded that Kim signed a contract for denuclearization, and he hopes that Kim will keep his word . Difficult words: bound (to be forced to do something), suspension (the act of stopping something), denuclearization (the act of removing nuclear weapons from a place), keep your word (to keep your promise). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Kim Jong-un, the leader of North Korea, said that North Korea could start nuclear tests and introduce a new weapon soon. The last test of a long-range weapon took place in November 2017. North Korea and the US signed a deal, and North Korea promised to remove all nuclear weapons. However, Kim’s opinion changed because the US imposed more sanctions on the country and continued military trainings with South Korea. Kim stopped negotiations with the US government, but the US president, Donald Trump, said that the relationship between North Korea and the US is very good. Trump hopes that Kim does not start the nuclear tests and that he continues to remove nuclear weapons. Difficult words: long-range weapon (a weapon that can hit an object that is very far), remove (to put away), impose (to force somebody to accept something), sanction (a punishment that one country does to another country, such as stop business with that country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a deal between North Korea and the US. It is about nuclear weapons . North Korea promises to stop all nuclear tests. It can put away its nuclear weapons. Last week, the leader of North Korea says that he wants to test a new weapon soon. He is angry because the US starts new sanctions against North Korea. Also, the US continues military training with South Korea. North Korea does not like this. The US president is hopeful. He says that the relationship between the US and North Korea is good. He hopes that the leader of North Korea does not start nuclear tests again. Difficult words: nuclear weapon (a bomb that is very dangerous and can destroy a very large area), sanction (a penalty that one country does to another country), relationship (the way in which two or more people or groups feel towards each other). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tens of thousands of protesters gathered in Hong Kong for a New Year’s Day protest. The protest was originally authorized by Hong Kong officials, but after some protesters clashed with police, that permission was quickly withdrawn . According to the police, some protesters set fires, damaged stores, and threw bricks, but the organizers of the protest denied that report, saying that the police just wanted to separate Hong Kongers. Demonstrations, which started from a controversial extradition law, have lasted for over six months. Officials from 18 countries urged the Hong Kong leader to deal with the protesters’ demands; however, Hong Kong’s government said that its priority is to stop violence and restore social order as soon as possible. Difficult words: withdraw (to take back), extradition (the act of returning someone for a trial to another country where they were accused of a crime), restore (to bring back a previous state or situation), social order (how people behave in a country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Tens of thousands of people protested in Hong Kong on New Year’s Day. Hong Kong officials authorized the protest, but after some protesters clashed with police, they called it off . The police said that some protesters started fires and damaged shops, but the organizers of the protest said that this was not true, and that the police tried to separate people. Demonstrations started six months ago as a reaction to a new law to return foreign prisoners to their home countries. Officials from 18 countries told Hong Kong to solve the situation and deal with the protesters’ demands . However, Hong Kong wants to stop the protests and bring the situation back to normal. Difficult words: clash (to meet and start a violent conflict), call off (to cancel), demonstration (a protest), demand (something that somebody wants). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of people protest in Hong Kong. This is on New Year’s Day. Hong Kong officials authorize the protest. However there are some problems with protesters. They cancel the protest. Officials say that some protesters become violent . However, the organizers of the protest say that this is not true. The protests start six months ago. They are about a new law about prisoners. People do not agree with the law. They protest against it. They want to change many things in Hong Kong. One thing is the law to vote. Officials from many countries write a letter to the Hong Kong leader. They ask her to change the situation in the country. However, Hong Kong officials say that they must stop the protests first. Difficult words: authorize (to make something possible), violent (very strong and powerful), law (the system of rules in a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Saturday, the Samoan government unanimously approved the cancellation of the state of emergency, which was in place since November 2019. Under the state of emergency, schools were closed, young people could not attend public events and all citizens were ordered to get vaccinated. According to the Ministry of Health, more than 5,600 cases of measles have been reported since the outbreak began. The disease has killed 81 people, and most of them were children. According to the World Health Organization, 90% of babies received the measles vaccine in 2013. However, the number plummeted to 31% in 2018, due to the spread of false information, and a 2018 scandal where improperly prepared vaccines caused the deaths of two Samoan children. The government said that in December, 2019, approximately 95% of all eligible people in Samoa were vaccinated against measles. Difficult words: unanimously (with the agreement of all people in a group), plummet (to fall very quickly and suddenly), eligible (a state when a person has the right qualities or fulfills the necessary conditions). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Saturday, the Samoan government canceled the state of emergency, which started in November 2019. During this time, young people could not go to school and public places, and the government wanted to vaccinate all citizens . In 2013, 90% of Samoan babies got the measles vaccine, but the number fell to 30% in 2018. People did not want to get the vaccine because they believed some false information about it. Also, in 2018, there was a scandal when two children died after they got badly prepared vaccines, and the government stopped vaccinating people. Officials say that there were 5,600 cases of measles since the start of the epidemic last year. Measles killed 81 people, and most of them were children. Difficult words: citizen (a person who lives in a country or a town), scandal (an action or event that makes many people angry because it is wrong or bad), epidemic (a quick start of a disease when many people become ill). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The government in Samoa ends the state of emergency . It starts in November last year. At that time, very many people become ill with measles. It is an infectious sickness. It is dangerous for children. During the emergency, young people cannot go to schools. All people need the vaccination . In 2013, 90% of babies in Samoa get the vaccination. However, after some problems, the situation changes. In 2018, two children die. They get a bad vaccine. After this, people are scared. They do not want the vaccination. Last year, 5,600 people become sick from measles. 81 people die. Difficult words: state of emergency (a serious situation when a government needs extra help), infectious (a sickness that one person can pass very easily on another person), vaccination (an act when a doctor gives somebody an injection that keeps the person healthy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Saturday, Somalia saw the worst truck bomb explosion in over two years. It happened at a busy intersection in Somalia’s capital city of Mogadishu during rush hour . A police officer said on national TV that the explosion targeted a tax collection center. Media reports say that 79 people were killed, and more than 100 people were injured; however, officials say that more than 90 people are dead. No groups claimed responsibility, but the country’s president blamed the terrorist group Al-Shabab, which is linked to another terrorist group, Al-Qaeda. Al-Shabab claimed responsibility for a car bombing in Somalia earlier this year and three bombings last year. Difficult words: intersection (a point where two or more roads cross), rush hour (the time of the day when traffic is the heaviest), blame (to say that somebody is responsible for doing something bad). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Saturday, a bomb exploded in a truck in Mogadishu, which is the capital city of Somalia. It was the worst explosion in the last two years, and it targeted a tax center. It happened at a busy crossroads during the time of day when there were a lot of cars and people in the streets. Officials say that it killed more than 90 people and injured more than 100 people. No terrorist group said that it was responsible for the attack, but Somalia’s president believes that the terrorist group Al-Shabab did it. Al-Shabab has a connection with another terrorist group, Al-Qaeda, and Al-Shabab carried out another attack in Somalia earlier this year and three attacks last year. Difficult words: target (to choose something as an object of an attack), responsible (someone who does something bad and it is their fault), carry out (to do a task or an activity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A bomb explodes in a truck in Mogadishu. It is the capital city of Somalia. The explosion is very big. It kills many people. The bomb explodes on a very busy road. Officials say that more than 90 people are dead. 100 people are injured. It is not clear who is responsible for the explosion. Somalia’s president believes that the terrorist group Al-Shabab is responsible. This is because this is not the first explosion this year. Also, Al-Shabab carries out more attacks in the past. Al-Shabab has connection with another big terrorist group, Al-Qaeda. Difficult words: responsible (when someone does something bad and it his or her fault), carry out (to do a task or an activity), connection (a situation when more things or people have similar ideas or origin). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

6,000 protesters gathered outside the US embassy in Baghdad, Iraq, after last weekend’s US airstrikes. The five deadly airstrikes killed 25 people and hurt dozens of people in an Iran- backed militia group. Many of the protesters were part of that same militia group. Dozens of the protesters broke into the embassy, set things on fire, and broke windows before they went back outside. The US troops who were guarding the embassy fired tear gas at the protesters. The US sent large military helicopters to fly over the embassy as a show of force , and it sent about 100 marines to help. There were no plans to evacuate the embassy and no Americans were hurt. Iran says that it was not involved in the protests. Difficult words: backed (supported by someone or something), militia (a group of people who act like a military group or an army), a show of force (when you show that you are strong). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

6,000 protesters came to the US embassy in Baghdad, Iraq because of US airstrikes that happened last weekend. The five deadly airstrikes killed 25 people and hurt dozens of people in a militia group that Iran supports. Many of the protesters were part of that same group. Some of the protesters broke into the embassy, burned things, and broke windows. The US soldiers who were guarding the embassy fired tear gas at the protesters. There were no plans to evacuate the embassy and no Americans were hurt. Iran says that it was not part of the protests. Difficult words: airstrike (an attack on something with a flying vehicle such as a plane), militia (a group of people who are similar to an army), tear gas (a gas that hurts people’s eyes and it makes them leave an area). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last weekend, the US uses planes to attack a militia group in Iraq. The attacks kill 25 people. They hurt more people. Then 6,000 protesters go to the US embassy in Baghdad, Iraq. They are angry about the attacks. Many of the protesters are from the militia group. Some of the protesters get into the embassy. They burn things. They break windows. The US soldiers try to protect the embassy. They use a gas that hurts the protesters’ eyes. No Americans are hurt in the protests. People do not have to evacuate the embassy. Iran supports this militia group. Iran says that it is not part of the protests. Difficult words: militia (a group of people who are like an army), protester (a person who says or does things to show he does not agree with a government or leaders), embassy (a building that a country keeps in another country so the two countries can work together), evacuate (to leave a dangerous place). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Australia, about 100 fires continue to burn; about 7.5 million acres have been scorched so far. In the state of Victoria, tens of thousands of residents had to evacuate due to the fires. However, officials told residents who live in remote places that it was too late to leave, so they should take shelter indoors. 11 people have died in these fires. One volunteer firefighter died during a fire and two were injured when high winds rolled their truck. Hundreds of thousands of people signed a petition to cancel Sydney’s New Year’s Eve fireworks show. They want to use the $4.5 million for the show to help firefighters or the people affected by the fires. The Australian Prime Minister said that he will not cancel the show. Difficult words: scorch (to burn), remote (far away from cities or other places), sign a petition (to sign a document that asks the government to change something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Australia, about 100 fires are raging , and fires burned about 7.5 million acres so far. In the state of Victoria, tens of thousands of people evacuated because of the fires. However, officials told people who live far from cities that it was too late to leave, and they should take shelter indoors. Hundreds of thousands of people are asking the government to cancel a New Year’s Eve fireworks show in Sydney. They want to use the $4.5 million for the show to help firefighters or people affected by the fires. The Australian Prime Minister said that he will not cancel the show. Difficult words: rage (to act violently or intensely), take shelter (to look for safety), affected by (when something causes something else to happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Australia, about 100 fires burn. Fires burn about 7.5 million acres of land there. Many residents must evacuate in the state of Victoria. They need to get away from the fires. However, some residents live in remote places. Officials tell them that it is not safe to leave. They tell them that they can stay safe indoors. Many people want the Australian government to cancel a New Year’s Eve show. They want to use the money from the show. They want to help firefighters. They want to help people who have problems from the fires. The Australian leader does not want to cancel the show. Difficult words: resident (a person who lives somewhere), evacuate (to leave a place because of danger), remote (far away from other places). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lufthansa has a low-cost carrier called Eurowings, which has had to cancel more than 170 flights due to a 3-day flight attendant strike. The flight attendants work for Germanwings, a business which runs flights in Germany. Their union has been stuck in a bitter dispute with Lufthansa due to part-time work rules, and the union told the flight attendants to strike. The canceled flights were scheduled from Monday through Wednesday of this week. Eurowings said that the strike was incomprehensible and that it wanted to give people normal flight schedules between Christmas and the New Year. The strike has not affected any Lufthansa flights yet. A past strike by the same union caused the airline to cancel 1,500 flights. Difficult words: carrier (a business that provides travel), bitter dispute (a disagreement that is difficult to end), incomprehensible (difficult to understand). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Lufthansa has a low-cost airlines business called Eurowings, which has had to cancel more than 170 flights because of a 3-day flight attendant strike . The flight attendants work for Germanwings, which runs German flights. Their union is fighting with Lufthansa about part-time work regulations , and the union told the workers to strike. The canceled flights were going to happen from Monday through Wednesday of this week. Eurowings said that it did not understand the strike, and it wanted to give people normal flight schedules between Christmas and the New Year. A past strike by this union made the airline cancel 1,500 flights. Difficult words: strike (this happens when workers stop work so they can get their business to help them with something), union (a group of people who help workers to have better conditions at work), regulation (a rule). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lufthansa has a cheap airlines called Eurowings. Eurowings has to cancel more than 170 flights. There is a 3-day long flight attendant strike . The flight attendants have a union . It tells them to strike. This is because the people in the union and Lufthansa do not agree. The union wants to make different rules for the workers for part-time work. The canceled flights happen this week from Monday to Wednesday. Eurowings is not happy. It wants to give people flights from Christmas to the New Year. Difficult words: flight attendant (the worker on a plane who helps people be comfortable and safe), strike (when workers do not work so that their business can help them with something), union (a group of people who help workers). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Russia says that it has successfully tested a national alternative to the global Internet. The Russian President, Vladimir Putin, said that this localized version of the global Internet would help Russia avoid being cut off and keep its sovereignty . There are not many details about the test, but the Russian government said that users did not notice a change. Many media outlets have pointed out that this is an ambitious and challenging project; however, it is not clear what stage Russia has reached, and there is also a question about the motivation of Russia. Critics say that this is a way for the country to police the content that users have access to. Difficult words: sovereignty (the freedom of a country to control itself), ambitious (difficult and challenging), motivation (what someone really wants). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Russia tested its version of the global Internet. There are not many details about the test, but Russian officials say that the test was successful and that users did not notice it. It is not clear what stage Russia reached, but media say that this is a very difficult project and it is not clear why Russia did it. Some people believe that the country wants to control users’ abiilty to see some content . The Russian President, Vladimir Putin, said that the country’s own Internet can help keep Russia independent and have its resources that nobody can cut off. Difficult words: stage (how much work was completed), content (the ideas that come when you write or speak), resources (something that people can use when they need it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Russia wants to have its own Internet. The country makes a test of it. There is not a lot of information about the test. However, officials say that it is successful. They say that Internet users do not have any problems during the test. The test is a complicated and difficult task. Many people wonder why Russia does it. Some people believe that Russia wants to have control over people. They want to have control over their activity on the Internet. The Russian President does not agree with this. He says that the country’s own Internet is important for its independence . Difficult words: user (a person who works on a computer), activity (something people do), independence (when a country or a person is free and does not need any help). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Taliban’s leadership has agreed to a temporary cease-fire . It will give the US and the Taliban about a week to work out a peace agreement, which would end the 18-year war in Afghanistan. As a condition, the US wants assurances that the country will not harbor terrorist groups. After over a year of negotiations, the US and the Taliban reached a peace deal, which involved withdrawing over 5,000 US troops from Afghanistan. However, Donald Trump, the US president, ended the negotiations later that month after the Taliban claimed responsibility for a suicide bombing in Kabul, which killed 10 Afghan civilians and one US service member. In November, Donald Trump said that the US will reduce the number of US troops in Afghanistan from around 12,000 to 8,600, but the US will not leave Afghanistan until there is a deal or a total victory of the US. Difficult words: cease-fire (an agreement between two armies to stop fighting in order to have discussions about peace), harbor (to keep someone safe), withdraw (to take away from a place or a position), suicide bombing (a bomb attack done by a person who wants to kill himself as well as other people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Taliban’s leaders agreed to stop fighting for a week to work out a peace deal with the US. This deal would end the war in Afghanistan, which started 18 years ago. As a condition , the US wants Afghanistan to promise that it will not support any terrorist groups in the future. Peace talks between the US and the Taliban lasted over one year, and as a result, over 5,000 US soldiers left Afghanistan. The situation became complicated again after a bombing in Kabul, which killed 10 Afghan people and one US soldier. The US president, Donald Trump, wants to reduce the number of US soldiers in Afghanistan from around 12,000 to 8,600. He said that the US soldiers must stay in Afghanistan until the end of the war. Difficult words: condition (a situation that must exist before something else can happen), support (to help), reduce (to make smaller in number). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a war in Afghanistan. It lasts 18 years. The leaders of the Taliban are the military group in Afghanistan. They agree to stop fighting for one week. They want to continue peace talks with the US, the talks are long and difficult. The US wants that Afghanistan does not help any terrorists . The peace talks last one year. Many US soldiers leave Afghanistan. However, after a bombing in the capital city, Kabul, the situation is difficult again. The US president wants to reduce the number of US soldiers in Afghanistan. He wants to reduce the number from 12,000 to 8,600. He says that the US soldiers must stay in the country until the end of the war. Difficult words: peace talk (a discussion between two or more countries that helps end a war), terrorist (a person who kills other people, usually to get some change in politics), reduce (to make smaller). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Omar al-Bashir was Sudan’s former president, and in April, the military took him out of his position. When he was the leader, people said that he had committed war crimes . Bashir is now in trials for several crimes. Recently, a judge found Bashir guilty of corruption and for illegally keeping foreign money. The judge gave him two years of detention in a reform facility instead of a prison. Sudanese law says that anyone over 70 does not go to prison if his crime is not punishable by death. Bashir is 75. However, Bashir has to stay in a maximum security prison now while the trials happen because one of the trials is about if he killed protesters; that crime could be punishable by death. If he is not guilty, he will go to a reform facility. Difficult words: commit war crimes (to do terrible crimes against people during a war), detention (a place to keep someone while people decide what to do with that person), reform facility (a place that is nicer than a prison where prisoners can learn how to be better people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Omar al-Bashir was Sudan’s past president. In April, the military took him out of his job because people said that he had done terrible crimes. He is now in trials for several crimes.
